outcome.answer: Several papers address multimodal LLM decoding strategies. [2] proposes training-free visual-redundancy-controlled decoding for diffusion-based multimodal LLMs by prioritizing visually complementary positions instead of independent confidence ranking. [1] and [3] also target diffusion multimodal decoding, with [1] emphasizing contextual utility and semantic anchors, while [3] focuses on neighbor support and block-free cluster decoding. [4] and [9] are decoding-time methods for reducing multimodal hallucinations, but they are aimed more at faithfulness than general decoding order.
